name: progress-panel
description: A pane beside every Claude Code chat showing the progress of every session on the machine, grouped by session

progressDir.title: Progress folder
progressDir.description: Folder every session writes its status file to. Empty = progress/ in the Claude config directory (~/.claude/progress). ~/ expands to your home directory.

autoClearDoneHours.title: Auto-clear done tasks after (hours)
autoClearDoneHours.description: Done and skipped tasks older than this are cleared. 0 = never.

keepEndedSessionsDays.title: Keep ended sessions (days)
keepEndedSessionsDays.description: An ended session is removed this many days after it ended. 0 = keep until dismissed.

ciCommand.title: Custom CI command
ciCommand.description: For a CI the panel has no built-in support for (Jenkins, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Woodpecker…): a command that prints a pipeline's status as JSON (format in the README). Placeholders {project}, {id}, {sha}, {host}, each filled inside its own argument; no shell; ~/ expands to your home. Empty = off.

paneColumns.title: Sidebar width (columns)
paneColumns.description: How wide the pane opens when docked beside a fullscreen chat (Claude Code caps it at 45% of the terminal; dragging its edge wins). 0 = Claude Code's default.

paneRows.title: Height above the prompt (rows)
paneRows.description: How tall the pane opens when a narrow terminal shows it full width above the prompt (dragging it wins). 0 = Claude Code's default (a third).

sortTasksBy.title: Sort tasks by
sortTasksBy.description: The starting order; the pane's Sort button changes it.

autoStart.title: Start in every new session
autoStart.description: on: every new session reports to the pane from the start. off: the panel loads but stays dormant (no reporting rule, no reminders, no automatic watches, the pane does not open by itself) until /progress on or the pane's switch turns it on for that session.

tasksDefault.title: Task lists in new sessions
tasksDefault.description: off: sessions report only what they are doing (now) and what needs you, no task list. /progress tasks on|off overrides it per session.

agentsDefault.title: Subagent reporting in new sessions
agentsDefault.description: off: subagents are not asked to report and their reports are ignored. /progress agents on|off overrides it per session.

pipelinesDefault.title: Pipelines in new sessions
pipelinesDefault.description: off: pushes are not watched and the agent's watch is ignored. /progress pipelines on|off overrides it per session.
